name: IU International University of Applied Sciences
description:
Want to study at a university known for its innovative programs and commitment to practical learning?

Renowned for its academic excellence in applied sciences, the International University of Applied Sciences (IU) has gained recognition locally and internationally.

The university emphasises practical learning in its courses, giving students hands-on experience and industry-relevant expertise.

About the University

Founded in 1998, the International University of Applied Sciences is one of the most popular universities in Germany.

International University of Applied Sciences (IU) offers bachelor’s, master’s and MBA degrees, including engineering, data science, IT & Technology, business and management, health and social care, marketing, social sciences, human resources, and logistics.

The institution’s faculty has experienced professionals and provides personalised attention and mentorship to students.

Want to know more? Discover why the International University of Applied Sciences might be the place for you!

Why the International University of Applied Sciences?

  • IU provides a wide range of courses and levels of study for international students. These courses include engineering, data science, IT & Technology, business and management, human resources, and logistics.
  • The university offers on-campus, distance learning and blended-learning programs in German and English.
  • IU’s campuses have students from all over the world, thus providing cultural immersion to students.

Student Life

The International University of Applied Sciences offers a dynamic and multicultural student body. Students can participate in a range of extracurricular activities, clubs, and events outside the classroom.

Participating in academic competitions, cultural events, or athletic competitions offers networking and personal development.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: The university provides domestic and foreign students with comfortable accommodations. There is also off-campus housing for people looking for different arrangements.

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: Modern laboratories, libraries, and collaborative areas enhance the academic experience. Students can access state-of-the-art facilities like modern laboratories and libraries with the latest technology.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: Students at IU can be involved in many student-led sports activities, clubs and societies. These include the IU Rugby Team, IU Basketball Team, IU Volleyball Team, IU Soccer Team, and the IU Tennis Team, to name a few.
